command:
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
as_root() {
  if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
    "$@"
  else
    sudo -n "$@"
  fi
}
as_root install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /usr/local/bin
cat <<'SCRIPT' | as_root tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance > /dev/null
#!/bin/sh
printf 'inventory maintenance completed at %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
SCRIPT
as_root chown root:root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
as_root chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
